votes.quote: In src/relay.ts, one `Relay` class holds both the rate limiter (`while (state.acceptedAt.length && now - state.acceptedAt[0]! >= 1000) ...` inside `accept()`) and the retry policy (`const nextDelayMs = tenant.initialBackoffMs * 2 ** (attempt - 1);` inside `drain()`). Time and network can be controlled (`now`, `sleep` and `deliver` are injected) and state is kept per tenant (`states = new Map<string, TenantState>()`). But rate limiting and retry policy are not separate units: there is no standalone limiter or backoff component.
